name: Kyle Zakrzewski
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Engineer, True Anomaly (space security / defense tech)
profile: US Air Force and Space Force veteran and aerospace engineer who co-founded True Anomaly in 2022 with Even Rogers, Dan Brunski and Tom Nichols; he leads design, development and production of the company's Jackal autonomous orbital vehicles and mission systems. True Anomaly raised a $650M Series D in 2026 at a reported ~$2B+ valuation.
interesting_fact: Before True Anomaly he was Orbital Warfare Chief of Training at the USAF 26th Space Aggressor Squadron - the unit that plays the adversary in space-warfare exercises - and earlier a Maintenance Flight Commander in the 4th Space Operations Squadron, where the four co-founders met.
deep_cut_fact: Alongside his service he worked 2017-2022 as a guidance, navigation & control engineer on national defense space systems at Ball Aerospace, after systems-engineering stints at Lockheed Martin and Honeywell Aerospace; he holds B.S. and M.S. degrees in Aerospace Engineering & Mechanics from the University of Minnesota. CEO Even Rogers calls him 'an extraordinary first-principles engineer.'
notes: Low public profile; best route is via True Anomaly press office. Rogers quote source: https://eclipse.capital/blog/defining-modern-space-security-even-rogers-co-founder-and-ceo-true-anomaly

name: Ritankar Das
current_role: Founder, Tala Health (agentic-AI healthcare) and founder of Titan Holdings (AI holding company)
profile: Scientist-entrepreneur who left a Cambridge machine-learning PhD to start Titan Holdings in 2014, an AI holding company that builds healthcare companies funded by its own exits. Titan's portfolio included Dascena (AI disease prediction, acquired by CirrusDx in 2022) and Forta Health (autism care, $55M Series A). In 2025 he launched Tala Health, which pairs AI agents with licensed clinicians and raised a $100M seed led by Sofreh Capital.
interesting_fact: Titan Holdings has no outside LPs: 'Our holding company itself is entirely funded by our exits,' Das told Fortune; former Merck chairman/CEO P. Roy Vagelos invested in Tala Health's $100M seed.
deep_cut_fact: He graduated from UC Berkeley at age 18 at the top of his class and has authored 100+ peer-reviewed research papers; Tala's advisers include Nobel laureate astrophysicist John Mather.

public_contacts.value: contact@talahealth.com (company; contact form has a 'Press' inquiry option)

notes: Holding-company / 'AI-era conglomerate' thesis is a strong podcast angle. Advisers listed on talahealth.com/about-us: Mathai Mammen, Uli Chettipally, John Mather.

name: Dean Bloembergen
profile: Dean Bloembergen is co-founder and CTO of Owner.com, the AI-driven online-ordering, website, app and marketing platform for independent restaurants that he built with CEO Adam Guild. Owner pivoted to commission-free online ordering in 2020, hit a $1B valuation in 2025 and later raised a $240M Series D; Bloembergen leads its technology and is a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree.
interesting_fact: Owner's 2021 $10.7M seed round (led by SaaStr Fund) drew angels including Naval Ravikant, Kimbal Musk, Dylan Field, Marcus Lemonis and The Chainsmokers.
deep_cut_fact: Before Owner he built technology for restaurant chains including Blaze Pizza and Sharky's; Owner says his own parents are small-business owners, which is why he 'deeply loves helping people like them.'
notes: Low public profile compared with CEO Adam Guild; outreach likely best via Owner.com/Guild. No published press email on owner.com.
